output_text: This repo builds `vis42.mcpb`, a Claude Desktop MCP Bundle with a Node.js stdio-to-HTTP proxy to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`. Answer `initialize` immediately; connect lazily on first request. Transport constructors never throw. The SSE fallback must wrap the `connect()` call. All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel. Tools are stripped to `{ name, description }` only.
